cards.name: Spirit of Flames
cards.officialText: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE monster from your GY. Gains 300 ATK during your Battle Phase only.

cards.name: The Rock Spirit
cards.officialText: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 EARTH monster from your GY. Gains 300 ATK during your opponent's Battle Phase only.

cards.name: Garuda the Wind Spirit
cards.officialText: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 WIND monster from your GY. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

design.sharedSummonCost: The exact copy must be in the active physical representative's private hand. The team must have an open shared Monster Zone and a same-Attribute monster in the shared Graveyard. Pay exactly one physical UID to the shared banished zone, then Special Summon the Spirit from that hand; partner hand is never searched.
design.spiritOfFlames: Adds 300 ATK only while its controller's Battle Phase is active; no persistent atkBoost mutation and no bonus during opponent's Battle Phase.
design.rockSpirit: Adds 300 ATK only while the opponent team's Battle Phase is active; no persistent atkBoost mutation and no bonus during its controller's Battle Phase.
design.garuda: Once per turn during the opponent's End Phase, choose one face-up monster controlled by the opposing team and change its battle position. Preserve target UID, reject face-down/current-position/position-locked targets and do not bypass the shared 3-zone layout.
design.ownership: Banish cost remains the physical owner's card/UID in the team's shared banished zone; summoned Spirit retains its physical UID and owner seat.
